title: Ceraghit
description: Storefront, orders, mail and jobs of the Ceraghit api. Streams come from OTLP: metrics as ceraghit_* and http_server_duration, traces as default, logs as ceraghit.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '5 minute') AS ts, status_class, count(*) AS requests FROM "http_server_duration" WHERE deployment_environment = '$env' GROUP BY ts, status_class ORDER BY ts
SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '5 minute') AS ts, route, approx_percentile_cont(value, 0.95) AS p95 FROM "http_server_duration" WHERE deployment_environment = '$env' GROUP BY ts, route ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Orders created and paid, per currency
panels.description: Never sum TND and EUR: split by currency first

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 hour') AS ts, currency, sum(value) AS created FROM "ceraghit_orders_created" WHERE deployment_environment = '$env' GROUP BY ts, currency ORDER BY ts
SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 hour') AS ts, currency, sum(value) AS paid FROM "ceraghit_orders_paid" WHERE deployment_environment = '$env' GROUP BY ts, currency ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Amount received per currency (minor units)
panels.description: ceraghit.orders.amount_paid, millimes for TND and cents for EUR

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 day') AS ts, currency, sum(value) AS amount FROM "ceraghit_orders_amount_paid" WHERE deployment_environment = '$env' GROUP BY ts, currency ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Emails sent and failed
panels.description: A failed order mail is retried from the dashboard, but a burst means the sending domain is in trouble

queries.query: SELECT kind, sum(value) AS failed FROM "ceraghit_emails_failed" WHERE deployment_environment = '$env' GROUP BY kind ORDER BY failed DESC

panels.title: Scheduled jobs
panels.description: ceraghit.cron.runs and its duration, newest first

queries.query: SELECT job, result, sum(value) AS runs, max(value) AS longest_ms FROM "ceraghit_cron_duration_ms" WHERE deployment_environment = '$env' GROUP BY job, result ORDER BY job
SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '30 day') AS ts, model, sum(value) AS tokens FROM "ceraghit_ai_tokens" WHERE deployment_environment = '$env' GROUP BY ts, model ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Recent error logs
panels.description: Stream ceraghit: what the error alert mails about

queries.query: SELECT _timestamp, service, msg, request_id, trace_id FROM "ceraghit" WHERE level = 'error' AND deployment_environment = '$env' ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 50
